procedure.sampling: simple random sample of 100 from 63,688 closed strict-bug cohort issues, numpy default_rng (seed 20261120), without replacement
procedure.reviewer: single reviewer (report author) assisted by an LLM, reviewing title + first 1200 chars of the issue body against a written bug definition; automated review, NOT independent double-human validation

notes: precision = share of sampled strict-labelled issues judged genuine bug reports; the complementary error is recall, which this procedure does NOT estimate
